review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this planning-only bundle. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 consistently specify exact-key, live-map listener counts and preservation of existing behavior and typing. The exact writable scope includes the implementation and both regression owners without requiring gratuitous edits. Repository configuration and the supplied upstream build evidence support treating root declarations and dist as generated artifacts, rebuilding before root-import runtime and type checks, and not treating generated declarations as separately maintained owners. Stable task keys, implementation/verification relationships, and the verification dependency agree with the PRD. The designated implementer and independent verifier have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, including shared-state/data capabilities and the verifier's additional testing.verification claim; pending legacy claims and Persona are not needed to justify eligibility. A separate configured reviewer supports the earlier risk-review prerequisite. No unresolved material DEC-001 or hypothetical C input is present in this bundle, so neither supplies a decisions-stage blocker. Ready with no blocking reasons is coherent as a planning expectation, not an assertion that work has been executed or dispatched. Repository identity, file fingerprints, and release-input source/team/model/policy fields are consistent across the supplied records. The provenance explicitly explains the distinct source-digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Historical project reuse and the retained old operation do not contradict the stated absence of candidates on this bundle. I reviewed the supplied evidence only, relied on the Service's mechanical digest bindings, and did not recompute digests, execute code, or create human attestations.
